en.askTitle: Put in your own age, dates, budget and health history to see which nomad health plans actually fit and which ones exclude your condition
en.runTitle: A 34-year-old UK freelancer with mild asthma: seven health plans compared for six months in Thailand and six in Portugal on £150 a month

fields.label: Passport and residence facts
fields.value: UK-based freelance designer; NHS cover won’t help abroad

fields.label: Exact UK–Thailand–Portugal dates
fields.value: from February 2027: about 6 months in Chiang Mai, Thailand, then 6 months in Lisbon, Portugal

fields.label: Medical history and prescribed treatment
fields.value: mild asthma, controlled with an inhaler

fields.label: Written offers from insurers
fields.placeholder: e.g. a written quote or an acceptance letter naming asthma

fields.label: Visa route
fields.value: a Portuguese digital-nomad or residence visa, and Thailand’s long-stay remote-worker visa

en.template: Compare health cover for {passport}, {age}, {dates} and {budget}. Use {history} and {offers} to separate accepted asthma admissions, routine care, medicines and evacuation from exclusions. Show deductibles, annual commitments, total payment cost, UK-visit rules and the certificate needed for {visa}. Keep unconfirmed cover and dated prices clear. Plan only; do not apply, contact insurers, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Three colleagues read the official terms in parallel: SafetyWing and Genki, IMG, Cigna and Allianz, and the Portugal and Thailand visa insurance rules
phases.note: Plan wording, prices, exclusions for existing conditions, and what each visa asks for
phases.judgment: It would not take an insurer’s headline at face value: SafetyWing’s public FAQ says existing conditions are excluded while the actual contract allows conditional acceptance, and its calculator shows two prices (US$177.50 and US$161.50), so the plan is flagged as not assumed to cover asthma.

phases.title: Build the comparison page and a dated record of sources and calculations, with a fallback path if asthma isn’t covered
phases.note: Seven plans side by side, each with its price status and asthma treatment
phases.judgment: It did not crown a winner it could not verify: no plan was confirmed to cover asthma within £150 a month. SafetyWing Complete’s advertised price converts to about £131.88 a month, inside the budget, but its conflicting wording means it is not recommended without conditions, and the page points her to get explicit asthma acceptance from Genki, Cigna or Allianz first.

phases.title: Independent review of calculations, asthma claims and visa claims against the raw documents, plus desktop and phone layout checks
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer rechecked the exchange-rate conversions, monthly and annual totals and day counts, and traced the asthma warnings back to the insurers’ own wording. It confirmed that no unsupported “asthma-safe within £150” winner is claimed.

workers: Read the official terms and prices for the SafetyWing and Genki plans, focusing on how existing asthma is treated
Read the official benefits and medical underwriting rules for IMG, Cigna Global and Allianz Care
Checked the insurance rules for Portugal’s remote-work visas and Thailand’s long-stay visa, and looked at travel insurance as an alternative
Independent review of the finished page: rechecked calculations, asthma claims and visa claims against the raw documents
